feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Contributions to the Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) repository are open to all interested parties, not limited to official editors. Reviewing open pull requests and providing well-considered, constructive feedback is highly encouraged as a meaningful way to participate in the ongoing development process.
Engagement through such contributions is recognized within the community and can strengthen a candidate’s prospects for being considered for roles such as BIP Editor. The pace of discussions and developments may be gradual, echoing historical trends observed over previous years.
Active participation and valuable input from contributors play an important role in garnering support and trust for those aspiring to take on editorial responsibilities within the BIP framework.
